ben-bukhri.name: Ben Bukhri
ben-bukhri.bio: A Tanna who testified at Yavne that a priest who contributes the half-shekel is not a sinner (Shekalim 1:4).
ben-bukhri.prompt: A grave, earnest man in his 50s with a greying dark beard and a plain undyed wool mantle, standing as if giving testimony before the court. The Yavne study hall softly behind him.
